title: How Did Four Pandavas Fall Without a Battle?
hooks: Mahabharata ke chaar sabse shaktishali yoddha bina yuddh ke achanak bejaan kaise pad gaye?
Ek ghoont paani ne chaar mahabali yoddhaon ko kaise mita diya?
Duniya ka sabse bada aashcharya kya hai? Yaksha ka wo sawal jisne Pandavon ko hila diya.
hook_why: Immediate high-stakes paradox: four unconquerable warriors fall unconscious not to weapons or armies, but to a mysterious sip of water.
metaphor: The Enchanted Lake of Truth: a clear mirror reflecting the lethal poison of pride and the lifesaving power of humble wisdom.

scenes.vo: Could you stay this patient when dying of thirst? Tell us below!
scenes.prompt: A serene lotus pond reflecting warm golden evening sky, delicate ancient Indian miniature border motifs around edges, tranquil sacred water ripples, painterly cinematic Indian miniature-meets-epic style, no text
scenes.title: THINK ABOUT IT

caption:
The Yaksha Prashna from the Mahabharata teaches that patience surpasses raw power, and humility outshines pride. When four mighty warriors fell to their thirst and arrogance, only Yudhishthira's calm wisdom saved them.

If you were in their shoes, could you show such restraint? Tell us in the comments!
